paragraphs.text: Students aged 16 to 21 who are in full-time education can buy a Greenway Student Pass, which gives unlimited travel on all Greenway buses for either one month or a full academic year.
The monthly pass costs £28 and the annual pass costs £240. Passes can be bought through the Greenway app or at the travel shop in the bus station; they are not sold on buses.
To apply, you will need a photo and a letter from your school or college confirming that you are a full-time student. Applications made through the app are normally approved within two working days.
The pass is valid at all times, including evenings and weekends, but it cannot be used on the airport express service, which requires a separate ticket.
If your pass is lost or stolen, a replacement can be ordered through the app for £10. Passes cannot be transferred to another person.
